# Vedant Pawar

> Product-minded software engineer based in Mumbai, India. Owns product end to end (scope, design, build, ship, measure) as a full-stack developer at Tekkers AI, a US startup. Open to product engineering, product management, data & analytics, full-stack development and Founder's Office roles. Open to relocating.

Key facts:
- Current role: Full-stack developer → de facto product owner at Tekkers AI (Houston, US · remote), Aug 2025 – present. Owns 10+ features end to end with no PM or designer.
- Signature result: shipped "Live Predictions" from scratch; it became the app's #1 user-acquisition driver within weeks.
- Education: B.E. Computer Engineering, VESIT Mumbai (2021–2025), CGPA 9.56.
- Wins: DevIgnite Hackathon 1st (Mar 2024), Datazen Datathon 1st (Feb 2024), J.P. Morgan Code for Good top 6 from VESIT (Jul 2024).
- Leadership: CodeCell VESIT Student Head; ran a 600+ participant hackathon and 1300+ attendee workshops; raised ₹1.3L cash + $1000 in kind from sponsors.
- Core skills: Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, Flutter, FastAPI, Firebase, SQL, Snowflake, Pandas, PostHog, Power BI, Tableau, Figma, LLM apps.
- Contact: hello.vedantp@gmail.com
